text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her defeat in the Satsuki Sho, 
Biwa Hayahide immediately set out to 
reconstruct her "theories." However—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What shattered her "theory" was Narita 
Taishin's extraordinary fighting spirit. 
That wasn't something that could be easily 
calculated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Winning Ticket, dreaming of 
conquering the Derby, shouts her resolve 
to win as if convincing herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fierce determination of both rivals 
looms over the Japanese Derby. Will she be 
able to reconstruct her "theory" in 
time...?
